label: aqa-seed
note: Mirrors the Customer account access epic used in the Azure DevOps sandbox (AB#42/AB#44), so one story can be run from both trackers and the facts compared.

description: Everything a customer does to get into and out of their Juice Shop account: registering, signing in and signing out.
Target: OWASP Juice Shop running locally at http://localhost:3100. Test accounts only.

stories.summary: Customer signs in with email and password
description: As a registered customer I want to sign in with my email and password so that I can see my basket and orders.
The login page is at /#/login and is reached from Account > Login.
acceptance: AC-1: A registered customer who enters a correct email and password is signed in and taken to the product list.
AC-2: A wrong password shows the message "Invalid email or password." and the customer stays on the login page.
AC-3: The Log in button stays disabled until both email and password have been entered.

subtasks.summary: Show an error message when the credentials are wrong

description: As a signed-in customer I want to sign out so that nobody else using this browser can act as me.
acceptance: AC-1: Choosing Account > Logout signs the customer out; the Account menu then offers Login again.
AC-2: After logout the browser returns to the storefront home page.

subtasks.summary: Remove the authentication token from the browser on logout

comments: Product owner: returning to the storefront home page after logout is intended. Do not treat it as a defect; the login page is not where a signed-out customer should land.

description: As a new customer I want to create an account so that I can place orders.
The registration page is at /#/register and is reached from the login page ("Not yet a customer?").
acceptance: AC-1: A new customer who fills in email, password, repeat password, a security question and its answer can register and is sent to the login page.
AC-2: The Register button stays disabled while the password and the repeated password differ.
AC-3: Registering with an email that already has an account is refused with a message saying so.

subtasks.summary: Check that password and repeat password match before enabling Register

bugs.summary: Session token is still accepted after logout
description: Steps: sign in, copy the token from the browser, sign out, call GET /rest/basket/<id> with the copied token.
EXPECTED: 401, because the customer has signed out.
ACTUAL: 200 with the basket contents. The token is only removed from the browser; the server still accepts it.
Filed by a person, not by attestqa.
